result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape`. The `cli` module compiles and its tests pass, but I did not run the new help text or an actual landscape generation, because running the CLI directly was blocked in this session.

What changed:

- **`Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description. It is listed in the no-argument overview right after `updateLandscape`, and both use the landscape options.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: the dispatch accepts either name and routes to the same `updateLandscape` handler, so options, metadata, `-date`, `-timeout`, and `-recursive` behave identically. `-help` prints the usage under the name the user typed, with the `analyzeLandscape` description when that name is used. The `updateLandscape` help is unchanged.
- **`README.md`**: the README had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Landscape report" section covering both names and pointing to `analyzeLandscape -help`.

Nothing is committed.
